home.title: Science, all in one place
home.subtitle: An open directory of scientific articles, podcasts, channels, and outreach websites.
home.step1: Open the Submit page from the menu or the button below.
home.step2: Enter a title, a summary of up to 500 characters, the source link (starting with http:// or https://), the subject area, format, and content language.
home.step3: Enter the institution or author and, if you like, up to 8 tags to make it easier to find.
home.step4: Enter your name and email, describe your relationship to the content, and accept the Privacy Policy.
home.step5: Click Submit for review. Your resource will only become visible after the team approves it.

submit.title: Submit a resource
submit.intro: Anyone can suggest content. It will become visible after review by the team. We do not host the material; we link to its original source.
submit.success: Received! Your resource will be reviewed before publication.
submit.submitterIntro: We do not collect personal data. The sole purpose of this page is to enable contact between authors and readers interested in the content. If you have questions, contact us at
submit.optionalContacts: Optional contact details and social links to promote your work:
submit.consentPrefix: I have read and agree to the
submit.consentSuffix: I authorize the public display of my name and the social media/website links I provide, and allow my email and phone number to be shown to visitors who choose to view the contact details.
submit.cooldown: Please wait a few seconds before submitting another resource.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controller: Portal SciBR is an open-source initiative maintained by volunteers. The project maintainers are responsible for processing personal data.
privacy.requiredData: name, email, and your relationship to the submitted content.
privacy.optionalData: phone/WhatsApp, Instagram, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and website/Lattes.
privacy.consentData: A record of your consent (date and policy version) and, temporarily, an anonymous identifier (IP hash) for visitors who request contact details. It is deleted within 24 hours and used only to limit abuse.
privacy.use: To identify who submitted a resource, allow the team to review it, and let interested people get in touch or learn about the work. Legal basis: your consent (Brazilian LGPD, Article 7(I)).
privacy.publicName: Your name, relationship to the content, and the social media/website links you provide appear on the resource card.
privacy.hiddenContact: Your email and phone number are not displayed on the page. They are shown only when a visitor clicks “Show email and phone,” subject to per-person query limits. This reduces, but does not eliminate, automated collection.
privacy.moderationAccess: The moderation team can access all submitted data. We do not sell or share your data with third parties.
privacy.retention: While the resource is published or until you ask us to remove it. Rejected submissions may be deleted by moderators.
privacy.rights: At any time, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, or deletion of your data, and withdraw consent (LGPD, Article 18). If you withdraw consent, we will delete your personal data from the resource card.
privacy.contactSuffix: and include the resource card link.
privacy.contactUnavailable: Contact channel for data subject requests: to be provided by the maintainers.
privacy.minors: We do not accept submissions from anyone under 18 without authorization from a legal guardian. Never publish another person's data without their permission.

about.title: About Portal SciBR
about.intro: Portal SciBR is an open-source initiative dedicated to mapping, cataloging, and bringing together science communication projects, content, and initiatives across Brazil.
about.directory: We are an open directory: we do not host original content, but make it easier to discover through search and filters by subject area, format, and topic, directing visitors to creators and researchers.

guidelines.title: Curation guidelines
guidelines.intro: To be published, a resource must:
guidelines.publicSource: link to a public, verifiable source;
guidelines.brazilRelation: be related to science and science communication produced in or intended for Brazil;
guidelines.evidence: be evidence-based and not promote misinformation or pseudoscience;
guidelines.appropriate: not be spam, deceptive advertising, or inappropriate content.
guidelines.review: Every submission is reviewed by the team before it becomes visible on the portal.
